Sentiment analysis.

Score each text row with VADER (its lexicon and rules: negation, boosters, capitals, but, emoticons, emojis) and add the scores beside the columns, so the label and the split stay.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Text](../categories/text.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `SentimentAnalyzer` |
| Search words | sentiment, opinion, polarity, vader |
